title.en: Vithai Nel: Mangaiyaraai Pirappatharke (விதை நெல்: மங்கையராய்ப் பிறப்பதற்கே...)

text.en: Women who excelled in many fields are like seed paddy for the future.

This lesson begins by calling the world a wide ground where some dance, some sing and some show other skills; those who win are many, and this is personality. It then introduces women of strong personality.
It presents women achievers and inspires girls to follow their talents.
Terms: ஆளுமை (personality), மங்கை (woman), விதைநெல் (seed paddy) and சாதனை (achievement).
